items.title: 9.7.3 Importance of Collaboration and Iteration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the importance of collaboration and iteration (PDF 221-222).

blocks.text: Tawun pecheeda masail hal karne ke liye ilm aur maharatein jama karta, aur iteration har qadam par kaam nikharta hai. Pakistan mein mohalle ki safai muhimmat mein log mansooba banate ke kahan se shuru karein, phir kaam lamba hone ya zyada razakar chahiye hone par mansooba badalte (iterate), aur ilaqa saaf hone tak mil kar kaam karte (collaborate) hain. Kitab mazeed kehti hai ke Indus Valley tehzeeb ne shehri mansooba bandi aur tameer mein tawun aur iteration ki ibtidai misalein dikhayin (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Naye karobar ki kamyabi mein tawun aur iteration kaise hissa dalte hain? Misalein dijiye (long question 8).
blocks.explanation: Tawun mukhtalif maharaton wale shurakaa lata hai, jaise baker aur business manager mil kar ek plan likhte hain, to kaam batta aur khayalat behtar hote hain. Iteration saada version launch kar ke gahakon ki raye leta aur baar baar behtar karta hai, jaise juice ki dukaan pehle mahine ki sales ke baad menu badalti hai, to product market par behtar baithta aur ghaltiyan chhoti rehti hain. Mil kar yeh khatra kam karte aur karobar ko badalta rakhte hain.

items: Tawun aur iteration mil kar behtar nataij aur kam khatra dete hain (safai muhimmat).
